name: I14Y
documentComment:
This SBOM enumerates every unique (name, version) package tuple across the I14Y frontend (npm, both UIs) and backend (NuGet, full solution).
Human-readable third-party license inventories with SPDX identifiers, license URLs, and per-scope tables are maintained alongside this file:
- THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md (direct dependencies, one row per package)
- THIRD-PARTY-TRANSITIVE-LICENSES.md (transitive dependencies)
Relationship modeling limitation: parent-child dependency edges are not derived by the current generator. All non-root packages are attached to the root repository package via DEPENDS_ON as a flat inventory. Consumers MUST NOT infer that every package is a direct dependency of I14Y; direct vs. transitive classification is preserved in the two Markdown files above and in the tmp/ evidence artifacts.
